title: Barca
summary: Raleigh names Barca in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Barca, sonne of Mettimus, who went with his sister Elisa to Carthage. The Barcae came of him. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book II, Part I, Chapter VIII, §. II, sig. 234a
